name: suno-companion-pro
description: Professional DAW tools for Suno AI

scripts.build:chrome: mkdir -p dist/chrome/icons && cp src/manifest.json dist/chrome/ && cp src/icons/* dist/chrome/icons/ && cp src/popup.html dist/chrome/ && terser src/content.js -o dist/chrome/content.js -c -m && terser src/background.js -o dist/chrome/background.js -c -m && terser src/popup.js -o dist/chrome/popup.js -c -m && cleancss -o dist/chrome/styles.css src/styles.css
scripts.build:firefox: mkdir -p dist/firefox/icons && cp src/manifest-firefox.json dist/firefox/manifest.json && cp src/icons/* dist/firefox/icons/ && cp src/popup.html dist/firefox/ && terser src/content.js -o dist/firefox/content.js -c -m && terser src/background.js -o dist/firefox/background.js -c -m && terser src/popup.js -o dist/firefox/popup.js -c -m && cleancss -o dist/firefox/styles.css src/styles.css
scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.zip: npm run zip:chrome && npm run zip:firefox
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run zip
